dailies.configuration.title: Dailies Settings
dailies.settings.title: Dailies settings
dailies.settings.open_file.tip: Opens config/dailies-client.toml, the file these settings are kept in. It can be edited by hand; a change made there shows here a moment after it is saved.
dailies.settings.open_file.failed: The settings file could not be opened
dailies.settings.save_failed: The setting could not be saved; the log says why
dailies.settings.search.tip: Finds settings by any words of their name or description. Typing anywhere on this screen starts a search.
dailies.settings.count.none: Every setting is at its default
dailies.settings.group.fold: Click to fold this group away
dailies.settings.group.unfold: Click to show the settings of this group
dailies.settings.reset.unchanged: This setting is at its default
dailies.settings.reset_group.tip: Puts every changed setting of %s back to its default
dailies.settings.custom.tip: Any other value: type it here
dailies.settings.colour.tip: One of the named colours, or any colour as #RRGGBB
dailies.settings.colour.wrong: A colour is one of the names in the list or six hexadecimal digits, as in #33AAFF
dailies.settings.language.wrong: A language is given by its two or three letter code, as in en or de
dailies.settings.number.whole: Only whole numbers; the nearest is %s
dailies.settings.number.low: Must be at least %s; the nearest allowed value is %s
dailies.settings.number.high: Must be at most %s; the nearest allowed value is %s
dailies.settings.address.no_scheme: An address starts with http:// or https://
dailies.settings.address.not_http: Only http:// and https:// addresses can be used
dailies.settings.address.bad_port: The port is a number from 1 to 65535
dailies.settings.address.bad_characters: This is not written as an address is
dailies.settings.test.tip: Asks the server at this address once, now, whether it is there. Dailies never contacts it otherwise unless Use AI Services is on.
dailies.settings.test.unknown_host: No machine of that name was found
dailies.settings.test.refused: Nothing is listening at that address
dailies.ui.list.watch.tip: Opens the chosen recording. A double click on it does the same
dailies.ui.list.rename.tip: Gives the chosen recording another name
dailies.ui.list.delete.tip: Deletes the chosen recording for good, after asking
dailies.ui.list.open_folder.tip: Shows the folder the recordings are kept in
dailies.notice.failed: Recording failed. What was captured is kept and can be recovered
dailies.notice.pack_failed: A resource pack of this recording could not be applied. It plays without it
dailies.notice.disk_slow: Recording paused: the disk cannot keep up
dailies.ui.moments.tip: Open the moments page in your web browser: what happened while you played, the clips found in it, and what was said.
dailies.ui.notice.moments_page_opened: The moments page has opened in your web browser
dailies.ui.notice.moments_page_off: The moments page is served by Dailies' local server, which is switched off. Switch on "mcpEnabled" in the settings to use it
dailies.ui.notice.not_while_watching: A recording cannot be made while watching one
dailies.ui.notice.already_recording: A recording is already being made
dailies.ui.notice.join_first: Join a world or a server first
dailies.ui.notice.went_wrong: That did not work. The log says why
dailies.ui.pause.heading: Dailies
dailies.ui.finish.title: Name this recording
dailies.ui.finish.explanation: It is saved under this name
dailies.ui.cancel.title: Cancel this recording?
dailies.ui.cancel.question: Everything recorded so far will be thrown away.
dailies.ui.list.title: Recordings
dailies.ui.list.none_hint: Start one from the pause menu while you play
dailies.ui.list.name: %s
dailies.ui.list.finish_first: Finish or cancel the recording being made first
dailies.ui.list.close_first: Close this recording before changing it
dailies.ui.list.unreadable: The recordings folder could not be read
dailies.ui.list.folder_failed: The recordings folder could not be opened
dailies.ui.rename.title: Rename this recording
dailies.ui.rename.explanation: Only the name shown in this list changes
dailies.ui.rename.failed: The recording could not be renamed
dailies.ui.delete.title: Delete this recording?
dailies.ui.delete.question: "%s" will be gone for good.
dailies.ui.delete.failed: The recording could not be deleted
dailies.ui.recovery.title: Unfinished recordings
dailies.ui.recovery.found_one: One recording was not finished when the game last closed.
dailies.ui.recovery.found_many: %s recordings were not finished when the game last closed.
dailies.ui.recovery.explanation: Recovering keeps everything up to the last few seconds before the game closed.
dailies.ui.recovery.recovered_some: %1$s of %2$s recordings were recovered. The log says why the rest were not
dailies.ui.recovery.failed: The recordings could not be recovered
dailies.ui.recovery.discard_question: They will be gone for good.
dailies.ui.recovery.discard_failed: The unfinished recordings could not be discarded
dailies.ui.timeline.title: Timeline
dailies.ui.timeline.camera_help: Whether the camera follows its track or stays where you fly it
dailies.extras.key.mod_differences: Watching: list the mods that differ
dailies.extras.mods.notice: This recording was made with other mods: %1$s missing, %2$s extra, %3$s different. Press %4$s for the list
dailies.extras.mods.title: Mods that differ
dailies.extras.mods.explanation: Compared with the game this recording was made in
dailies.extras.mods.same: The mods installed are the ones this recording was made with.
dailies.editor.title: Editor
dailies.editor.close.tip: Close the editor and go back to flying freely. Everything is already saved
dailies.editor.side.fold: Fold this panel away, or bring it back
dailies.editor.timeline.fold: Fold the track rows away, or bring them back
dailies.editor.tab.keyframe.tip: The selected keyframe and its values, or buttons that add one at the playhead
dailies.editor.tab.looks.tip: How this scene looks: what is drawn, the weather and fog, the frame
dailies.editor.tab.export.tip: Turn this scene into a video, a set of pictures or one still picture
dailies.editor.scene.current.tip: The scene being edited. Click to change to another. Each scene has its own tracks, looks and export range
dailies.editor.scene.add.tip: Add an empty scene and change to it
dailies.editor.scene.rename.title: Rename the scene
dailies.editor.scene.rename.explanation: The name is only for you
dailies.editor.scene.duplicate.tip: Copy this scene with everything in it and change to the copy
dailies.editor.scene.remove.tip: Remove this scene with everything in it. Undo brings it back. The last scene cannot be removed
dailies.editor.range.label: Export range
dailies.editor.range.tip: The ticks of the recording this scene exports, both ends included. With none set, an export runs from the first keyframe to the last
dailies.editor.range.start.tip: First tick to export. Type a number and press Enter
dailies.editor.range.end.tip: Last tick to export. Type a number and press Enter
dailies.editor.range.start_here.tip: Make the export start at the playhead
dailies.editor.range.end_here.tip: Make the export end at the playhead
dailies.editor.transport.speed.tip: How fast the recording plays against how it was recorded
dailies.editor.transport.camera.tip: Lit: while the recording plays, the camera goes where the camera tracks send it. Unlit: it stays where you fly it. Flying off by hand switches this off
dailies.editor.timeline.pointer_video: %1$s (tick %2$s), %3$s into the video. Click or drag to jump
dailies.editor.timeline.range.tip: Export range, ticks %1$s to %2$s. Drag an end to move it
dailies.editor.timeline.keyframe.tip: %1$s keyframe at %2$s (tick %3$s). Click to select, Shift+click for more, drag to move, double click to jump to it, right click for more
dailies.editor.track.add.tip: Add a track for one kind of keyframe. Of two tracks of a kind, the upper one wins
dailies.editor.track.none: No tracks yet. Add a keyframe from the panel on the right, or a track with the button on the left
dailies.editor.track.enabled.tip: Ticked: the track takes part in playback and export
dailies.editor.track.up.tip: Move the track up. The upper of two tracks of a kind wins
dailies.editor.track.menu.tip: Rename, switch off, move, clear or remove this track
dailies.editor.track.name.tip: %1$s, %2$s keyframes. Click to select them all, right click for more
dailies.editor.track.rename.title: Rename the track
dailies.editor.track.rename.explanation: Leave empty to call it %s again
dailies.editor.track.remove.title: Remove this track?
dailies.editor.track.remove.question: "%1$s" and its %2$s keyframes will go. Undo brings them back.
dailies.editor.add.camera.tip: Where the camera is and how it is turned. Takes the view as it is now
dailies.editor.add.orbit.tip: The camera circles a point while looking at it. The point is the block in the middle of the view, or a spot a little way ahead
dailies.editor.add.follow_entity.tip: Ties the camera to an entity. You are asked to click the entity, or pick it from a list
dailies.editor.add.smart_camera.tip: The camera films a player by itself: chasing, standing still, circling, or choosing between those. You are asked for the player
dailies.editor.add.field_of_view.tip: How wide the lens is. Takes the field of view as it is now
dailies.editor.add.camera_shake.tip: A hand-held wobble on top of the camera
dailies.editor.add.speed.tip: How fast the recording plays in the video. Starts at 20 ticks a second, which is as recorded
dailies.editor.add.timelapse.tip: One end of a timelapse. Add a second one later on the same track: the stretch between them plays in the stated time
dailies.editor.add.freeze.tip: Holds the world still for a while, with the camera carrying on along its track
dailies.editor.add.time_of_day.tip: Sets the sky's time. Takes the time as it is now
dailies.editor.add.block_change.tip: Shows another block at a position from this tick on. You are asked to click the block
dailies.editor.add.audio.tip: An audio file from your disk that starts playing here and is put into exports. You are asked for the file
dailies.editor.add.heading: Add at the playhead
dailies.editor.add.note: Nothing is selected. Each button puts a keyframe on the tick the recording is at, on the uppermost track of its kind.
dailies.editor.add.default_blend.tip: How a new keyframe travels towards the next one. This is the editor's setting for it
dailies.editor.one.heading: %s keyframe
dailies.editor.one.deselect.tip: Go back to the buttons that add keyframes
dailies.editor.many.heading: %s keyframes selected
dailies.editor.many.note: Drag any of them along the timeline to move them all. Ctrl+C copies, Ctrl+V pastes at the playhead, Delete removes.
dailies.editor.keyframe.jump.tip: Take the recording to this keyframe's tick
dailies.editor.keyframe.paste.tip: Put the copied keyframes back, the first of them on the playhead (Ctrl+V)
dailies.editor.camera.take.tip: Set this keyframe to where the camera is now
dailies.editor.camera.go.tip: Put the camera where this keyframe says
dailies.editor.follow.pick.tip: Click an entity in the view, or pick one from a list
dailies.editor.smart.pick.tip: Click a player in the view, or pick one from a list
dailies.editor.smart.unknown_player: There is no player called "%s" in the recording at this tick. Type a name that is, or a UUID
dailies.editor.smart.director.note: The sizes of the director's own shots start from these:
dailies.editor.smart.stand_here.tip: Put the tripod where the camera is now
dailies.editor.timelapse.note: Timelapse keyframes pair up along their track: first with second, third with fourth. The time on the first of a pair counts.
dailies.editor.block.pick.tip: Click a block in the view to move this change there
dailies.editor.block.empty: Type a block, for example minecraft:oak_stairs[facing=north]
dailies.editor.block.unknown: That is not a block the game knows: %s
dailies.editor.audio.heading: Audio keyframe
dailies.editor.audio.note: Type or paste the path of an audio file on this computer. It starts playing at the playhead and is mixed into exports.
dailies.editor.audio.add.tip: Add the audio keyframe on the tick the recording is at
dailies.editor.audio.no_file: Type the path of an audio file first
dailies.editor.entity.absent: %s (not in the world at this tick)
dailies.editor.field.tick.tip: The tick of the recording the keyframe sits on. 20 ticks are one second
dailies.editor.field.blend.tip: How the value travels from this keyframe to the next one. Left click for the next way, right click for the one before
dailies.editor.field.yaw.tip: Which way the camera faces, in degrees: 0 south, 90 west, 180 north, -90 east
dailies.editor.field.pitch.tip: Looking up or down, in degrees: -90 straight up, 90 straight down
dailies.editor.field.roll.tip: Tilt to one side, in degrees
dailies.editor.field.centre_x.tip: The point the camera circles, east and west
dailies.editor.field.centre_y.tip: The point the camera circles, height
dailies.editor.field.centre_z.tip: The point the camera circles, north and south
dailies.editor.field.distance.tip: How far the camera is from what it films, in blocks along the ground
dailies.editor.field.height.tip: How far the camera is above what it films, in blocks
dailies.editor.field.angle.tip: The camera's heading as it looks at the centre, in degrees. Change it between two keyframes to swing round
dailies.editor.field.part.tip: The part of the entity's body the camera is measured from
dailies.editor.field.offset_x.tip: Blocks east or west of the body part
dailies.editor.field.offset_y.tip: Blocks above or below the body part
dailies.editor.field.offset_z.tip: Blocks north or south of the body part
dailies.editor.field.follow_mode.tip: Keep place: the camera stays the offset away from the entity. Stay and watch: the camera stays where it is and turns to watch
dailies.editor.field.fov.tip: In degrees, from 1 to 170. Small numbers zoom in
dailies.editor.field.strength.tip: How far the camera wobbles. 0 is none, 1 is plain to see, 10 the most
dailies.editor.field.ticks_per_second.ti: How fast the recording plays in the video. 20 is as recorded, 10 half speed, 40 double
dailies.editor.field.real_seconds.tip: Seconds of video the stretch up to the next timelapse keyframe plays in
dailies.editor.field.hold_seconds.tip: Seconds of video the world stands still for
dailies.editor.field.time.tip: In ticks of the day: 0 sunrise, 6000 noon, 12000 sunset, 18000 midnight
dailies.editor.field.block_state.tip: The block to show, written as the game writes it: minecraft:oak_stairs[facing=north]
dailies.editor.field.file.tip: The path of an audio file on this computer
dailies.editor.field.volume.tip: 1 is the file's own loudness, 0 silent, 2 the most
dailies.editor.field.target.tip: Who is filmed: a player's name or UUID
dailies.editor.field.smart_mode.tip: Chase follows, tripod stands and turns, orbit circles, director picks between them and cuts
dailies.editor.field.side_angle.tip: Degrees round the player from their heading: 0 behind, 90 to their right, 180 in front
Seconds the camera takes to catch up with the player. 0 is rigid
dailies.editor.field.heading_source.tip: Movement: the way the player travels, their body when nearly still. Body: always the way they face
dailies.editor.field.position_x.tip: Where the tripod stands, east and west
dailies.editor.field.position_y.tip: Where the tripod stands, height of the lens
dailies.editor.field.position_z.tip: Where the tripod stands, north and south
dailies.editor.field.aim_smoothing.tip: Seconds the tripod takes to turn after the player
dailies.editor.field.radius.tip: Distance from the player along the ground while circling, in blocks
How fast the camera circles. A minus sign turns it the other way
dailies.editor.field.start_angle.tip: The camera's heading on the keyframe's tick
dailies.editor.field.min_shot_seconds.ti: The director never cuts sooner than this
dailies.editor.field.max_shot_seconds.ti: The director always cuts by this
dailies.editor.field.allow_chase.tip: Let the director follow the player
dailies.editor.field.allow_tripod.tip: Let the director stand and turn
dailies.editor.field.allow_orbit.tip: Let the director circle the player
dailies.editor.field.seed.tip: The same number gives the same shots every time. Change it for a different edit
dailies.editor.field.screen_x.tip: Where the player sits across the picture: -1 the left edge, 0 the middle, 1 the right edge. A third is 0.333
dailies.editor.field.screen_y.tip: Where the player sits up the picture: -1 the bottom, 0 the middle, 1 the top
dailies.editor.field.lead_room.tip: From 0 to 1: how much space is left in front of a player moving across the picture
dailies.editor.field.auto_zoom.tip: Change the field of view so the player stays the same size in the picture
dailies.editor.field.subject_screen_heig: How much of the picture's height the player fills, from 0.05 to 1
dailies.editor.field.min_fov.tip: The narrowest field of view the zoom may use, in degrees
dailies.editor.field.max_fov.tip: The widest field of view the zoom may use, in degrees
dailies.editor.field.fixed_fov.tip: The field of view while this camera films. 0 leaves it alone
dailies.editor.field.frame_vehicle.tip: Also fit a vehicle, contraption or craft the player rides into the picture
When blocks come between camera and player, move the camera in front of them
Seconds the camera takes to move over from where it was. 0 is a cut
dailies.editor.field.block_x.tip: The block's position, east and west
dailies.editor.field.block_z.tip: The block's position, north and south
dailies.editor.choice.head: Head
dailies.editor.pick.heading: Choose in the view
dailies.editor.pick.follow: Click the entity the camera should follow
dailies.editor.pick.ride: Click the entity to ride along with
dailies.editor.pick.block_ahead: The block in the middle of the view
dailies.editor.pick.no_entities: There are no entities near the camera at this tick.
dailies.editor.pick.no_players: There are no players near the camera at this tick.
dailies.editor.notice.riding: Stop riding along first: the camera cannot fly while it rides
dailies.editor.notice.paste_past_end: Pasted here they would run past the end of the recording
dailies.editor.notice.setting_failed: The setting could not be saved
dailies.editor.error.gone: The keyframe is no longer there
dailies.editor.looks.show_hud.tip: Draw the hotbar, health and the rest of the recorder's HUD
dailies.editor.looks.show_name_tags.tip: Draw the names over players and named creatures
dailies.editor.looks.show_held_items.tip: Draw held items when seeing through someone's eyes
Draw the outline of the block being looked at
dailies.editor.looks.hidden_entity_types: Every entity of these kinds is hidden, for example minecraft:bat
dailies.editor.looks.hidden_particle_typ: Particles of these kinds are hidden, for example minecraft:rain
dailies.editor.looks.weather.tip: The weather shown, whatever was recorded
dailies.editor.looks.fog_mode.tip: As recorded, none, or your own with the three settings below
dailies.editor.looks.fog_start.tip: Blocks from the camera at which your own fog begins
dailies.editor.looks.fog_end.tip: Blocks from the camera at which your own fog hides everything. Not less than where it starts
dailies.editor.looks.fog_colour.tip: The colour of your own fog, as #RRGGBB
dailies.editor.looks.sky.tip: Draw the sky. When off, the background colour is drawn in its place, for keying
dailies.editor.looks.background_colour.t: The plain colour drawn in place of the sky when it is off, as #RRGGBB
dailies.editor.looks.night_vision.tip: Full brightness without the potion's tint
dailies.editor.looks.server_resource_pac: Show this scene with the resource packs the server gave the recorder. When off, only your own packs are used
dailies.editor.looks.fov.tip: Field of view in degrees when no track sets it. 0 leaves the game's own alone, otherwise 1 to 170
dailies.editor.looks.roll.tip: Camera roll in degrees when no camera keyframe sets it
dailies.editor.looks.aspect_guide.tip: A frame of this shape is drawn over the view as a guide
dailies.editor.looks.custom_aspect.tip: Width divided by height of the custom frame shape, for example 2.39
dailies.editor.looks.thirds_guide.tip: Rule-of-thirds lines, shown only while editing, never in exports
dailies.editor.looks.centre_guide.tip: A cross in the middle of the view, shown only while editing, never in exports
dailies.editor.looks.list.add.tip: Add the kind typed on the left to the list
dailies.editor.looks.list.empty: Type the id of a kind first, for example minecraft:bat
dailies.editor.looks.list.bad_id: "%s" is not an id. Ids look like minecraft:bat
dailies.editor.looks.list.unknown: Added %s, though this game does not know it
dailies.editor.looks.entity.heading: One entity
dailies.editor.looks.entity.heading.tip: Changes to single entities: hide one, rename it, change its glow, name tag, cape or armour
dailies.editor.looks.entity.pick.tip: Click an entity in the view, or pick one from a list, to change how it is shown
dailies.editor.looks.entity.name: Shown name
dailies.editor.looks.entity.name.tip: Another name to show over it. Empty shows the recorded one
dailies.editor.looks.entity.glow.tip: The glowing outline: as recorded, always on, or always off
dailies.editor.looks.entity.hide_nametag: Do not draw the name over this entity
dailies.editor.looks.entity.hide_cape.ti: Do not draw this player's cape
Do not draw the armour this entity wears
dailies.editor.looks.entity.reset.tip: Take back every change to this entity
dailies.editor.export.preset.tip: A named set of export settings. Choosing one fills in everything below; change anything and it is marked as modified
dailies.editor.export.preset.actions.tip: Save, add, rename or remove presets, or bring the built-in ones back
dailies.editor.export.preset.reset_done: The built-in presets are as they were made
dailies.editor.export.preset.save_failed: The presets could not be saved
dailies.editor.export.preset.name.tip: Type a name for the preset and press Enter
dailies.editor.export.preset.name_ok.tip: Keep the preset under this name
dailies.editor.export.preset.name_cancel: Leave the presets as they are
dailies.editor.export.preset.name_taken: There is already a preset called "%s"
dailies.editor.export.fallback.hardware: This computer has no hardware encoder for %1$s, and Dailies carries no software one, so %2$s is used instead.
dailies.editor.export.fallback.plain: This computer cannot encode %1$s, so %2$s is used instead.
dailies.editor.export.no_platform: Dailies carries a video encoder for %1$s only for now, and this is %2$s. Numbered PNG pictures can be exported here instead.
dailies.editor.export.pixels.tip: Width and height in pixels, each from 16 to 16384. Videos are rounded up to even numbers
dailies.editor.export.codec.missing: H.264 is not offered: this computer has no working hardware encoder for it, and Dailies carries no software one. AV1 plays on YouTube and in current browsers.
dailies.editor.export.quality.tip: How much of the picture is kept. High is what video sites ask of an upload; Custom lets you type a bitrate
dailies.editor.export.quality.master: %s has one quality, set by the codec itself
dailies.editor.export.bitrate.fixed: it follows the quality; choose Custom bitrate to type one
dailies.editor.export.apart.tip: Besides the mixed sound, keep the game, each speaker and the audio keyframes apart, all the same length: as WAV files beside the video, as named tracks inside an MKV or MOV, or both. For lowering music under speech or cutting one voice in a video editor
dailies.editor.export.apart.as_files: %s files are not given separate tracks: they will be written as WAV files beside the video.
dailies.editor.export.folder.tip: Where exports go: a folder inside the game folder, or a full path. Empty brings back dailies/exports
dailies.editor.export.folder.wrong: That is not a folder name this computer accepts
dailies.editor.export.overwrite: Replace a file of the same name
dailies.editor.export.overwrite.tip: Ticked, a file that is already there is written over. Unticked, the new file gets a number after its name
dailies.editor.export.too_long: The range makes %1$s of video. "%2$s" is meant for %3$s seconds at most.
dailies.editor.export.size.tip: Usual sizes. The picture may be larger than the window or the monitor
dailies.editor.export.width.tip: Width in pixels, from 16 to 16384. Videos are rounded up to an even number
dailies.editor.export.height.tip: Height in pixels, from 16 to 16384. Videos are rounded up to an even number
dailies.editor.export.rate.tip: Frames a second: a usual rate from the list, or any rate from 1 to 240 in the box beside it
dailies.editor.export.rate_free.tip: Any frame rate from 1 to 240, fractions allowed, for example 29.97
dailies.editor.export.supersample.tip: Draw every frame at twice the size and scale it down, for smoother edges. Slower
dailies.editor.export.hide_hud.tip: Do not put the HUD in the picture
dailies.editor.export.transparent.tip: Keep the background see-through. Needs the scene's sky switched off in Looks, and a format that can hold it
dailies.editor.export.asking: Asking the encoder what it can do...
dailies.editor.export.no_encoder: No video encoder works on this computer, so only pictures can be exported.
dailies.editor.export.container.tip: The kind of video file, or a folder of numbered pictures
dailies.editor.export.codec.tip: How the video is packed. Only what this computer can really encode is offered, the fastest first, each saying whether the graphics card or software does the work. H.264 and H.265 need a graphics card that encodes them
dailies.editor.export.encoder.tip: Which encoder does the packing. "Choose for me" tries the graphics card first, then software
dailies.editor.export.bitrate.tip: Bits a second of video, as a number or like 20m or 800k. More is better looking and larger. Worked out from the quality unless the quality is Custom
dailies.editor.export.bitrate.wrong: Type a number of bits a second, or something like 20m or 800k
dailies.editor.export.sound.tip: Put the game's sound in the file, with recorded voice chat and the scene's audio keyframes
dailies.editor.export.stereo.tip: Two channels. Unticked, the sound is mono
dailies.editor.export.sound_codec.tip: How the sound is packed. "Usual" takes AAC for MP4 and MOV, Opus for WebM and MKV. Uncompressed fits MOV and MKV
dailies.editor.export.name: File name
dailies.editor.export.name.tip: The name of the file, without its ending. These are filled in when the export starts: %s
dailies.editor.export.range.set: Exports the scene's range, ticks %1$s to %2$s: %3$s of video.
dailies.editor.export.range.default: No export range is set: exports ticks %1$s to %2$s, %3$s of video. Set one in the top bar.
dailies.editor.export.range.empty: There is nothing to export: the range starts at tick %1$s and ends at tick %2$s.
dailies.editor.export.start.tip: Render the range to the file, one frame at a time. The editor makes way for a progress display; Cancel there stops early and keeps what was done as a file that plays
dailies.editor.export.still.tip: Write one PNG picture of the view as it is now, at the size above
dailies.editor.export.not_now: Wait for the recording to finish loading or jumping
dailies.editor.export.result.done: Written: %s. Click to open the folder.
dailies.editor.export.result.cancelled: Stopped early. What was done is in %s. Click to open the folder.
dailies.editor.export.result.tip: How the last export went. Click to open the folder it wrote to
dailies.editor.export.folder_failed: The exports folder could not be opened
dailies.editor.progress.title: Exporting
dailies.editor.viewer.title: Viewer
dailies.editor.viewer.fold: Fold the viewer's controls away, or bring them back
dailies.editor.viewer.how: The movement keys fly the camera. Hold the right mouse button over the view to look around.
dailies.editor.viewer.speed.tip: How fast the camera flies, in blocks a second. The mouse wheel changes it while flying; the sprint key triples it
dailies.editor.viewer.fov.tip: The camera's field of view right now. While the recording plays, the scene's own (a track, or Looks) applies
dailies.editor.viewer.fov.reset: Back to the game's own field of view
dailies.editor.viewer.roll.tip: Tilt the camera to one side
dailies.editor.viewer.ride.tip: See through the eyes of an entity. Click it in the view, or pick it from a list
dailies.editor.viewer.leave.tip: Stop riding along and fly freely again
dailies.editor.viewer.momentum.tip: The camera glides to a stop instead of stopping dead
dailies.editor.viewer.look_relative.tip: Forward follows where the camera looks, up and down included. Unticked, forward stays level
